what: `switchboard unit claim` re-checks the unit's blockers, creates one claim file on fleet-state as a single pushed transaction, then mirrors it to the assignee and the in-progress label; `switchboard unit release` drops a claim and reaps stale ones.
expectations: Two claims of one unit started together: exactly one exits 0, the other exits 75.
A unit with an open blocker cannot be claimed.
Release removes the claim file, the assignee and the label.
A claim older than the stale limit is released by the reaper.
